name: Comet Crate
tagline: Swag that doesn't end up in a landfill by Tuesday.
positioning: Comet Crate is the merch platform for people who hate merch — curated goods, one dashboard, zero mousepads with your logo on them.

hero.sub: Pick from a shelf we already vetted, ship it anywhere, and skip the eight-week email chain with a vendor named Greg. Good swag, ordered like it's 2025.

features.title: A shelf, not a catalog
features.description: We curate 40 items that don't suck instead of dumping 4,000 on you. No stress balls. No lanyards. No regrets at the next all-hands.

features.title: Ship one or ship a thousand
features.description: Send a hoodie to one new hire or 900 conference attendees from the same screen. Addresses collected for you — nobody DMs you their zip code.

features.title: Live inventory, real numbers
features.description: See exactly how many mediums are left before you promise 300 of them. Restock alerts land before the shelf goes empty, not after.

features.title: Storefronts in a click
features.description: Spin up a branded shop your team or fans can order from directly. You set the budget, we handle the checkout, everyone gets the right size.

features.title: Proofs that don't crawl
features.description: Approve embroidery and print proofs in hours, not the standard ten-business-day fog. Reject Greg's kerning in one tap.

features.title: Returns without the sigh
features.description: Wrong size happens. Swaps and reships run through us so you never touch a shipping label or a padded envelope again.

testimonials.quote: We used to have a closet full of XL polos nobody wanted. Now our people request the crate. I have never once said that sentence about company merch before.
testimonials.name: Priya Raman

testimonials.quote: I run a newsletter with 12,000 subscribers and needed drops that felt premium without a warehouse in my garage. Comet Crate is the warehouse. My garage has a car again.
testimonials.name: Devon Marsh

testimonials.quote: Onboarded 60 remote hires last quarter, each got a box on day one, and I approved every proof from my phone. Our old vendor took longer to reply to email.
testimonials.name: Alina Ferreira
